item.title: Retail & Wholesale Food Ordering Platform
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I’m launching a combined website and mobile app for my food and beverage business and need it finished within seven days. The platform must display three price tiers—public, retail, and wholesale—with each customer automatically seeing the tier I assign in the admin panel. Sales reps get their own log-ins that let them enter any customer’s account and place orders on their behalf.
Inventory control is critical. When stock runs low, customers should receive a warning yet still be allowed to check out; once an item is sold out it disappears from their view while I receive an alert so I can restock promptly.
Design needs to stay clean, fast, and intuitive on both the web storefront and the companion app. I have a total budget of US $300–500, which we can split across clear milestones tied to visible progress.
Deliverables • Responsive website ready for desktop, tablet, and mobile • Cross-platform app (Play Store & App Store-ready builds or build-ready source code) • Admin dashboard covering price-tier assignment, user roles, inventory alerts, basic sales reports
Feel free to propose the stack you work fastest with—WooCommerce, Shopify plus custom scripts, Laravel + Flutter, MERN, or similar—as long as it supports secure payments, order history, and straightforward product uploads.
When you respond, please outline your chosen technology, how you’ll implement the three-tier pricing and sales-rep impersonation, and your timeline for hitting the seven-day deadline.

item.title: Performance-Based WooCommerce SEO Australia
item.description:
250-750 AUD | Hi Freelancer Team,
I own AusMotoGear (www.ausmotogear.com.au), an established Australian e-commerce business specialising in motorcycle clothing and protective riding gear.
I'm considering hiring an experienced SEO freelancer through your platform and would appreciate advice on how best to structure and advertise the project.
**My SEO requirements**
I have already identified approximately 40 relevant keywords, ranging from broad, competitive terms such as "motorcycle gear" to product-specific searches such as "leather motorcycle jackets", "Kevlar jeans" and "Kevlar hoodie".
I have historical Google Search Console data and independently monitor keyword rankings through SERPRobot ( Do not want to pay for Semrush or AHREFS, unless a freelancer can offer reports given that they get access if they manage more sites, I guess)
My main objectives are to:
1. Improve selected keyword rankings on **Google Australia**, particularly achieving first-page (top 10) positions. 2. Recover lost rankings for keywords that previously performed well. 3. Increase relevant Australian organic search traffic to our website. 4. Identify and address technical SEO issues that may be limiting performance.
**Preferred payment arrangement**
I am particularly interested in a **performance-based SEO model**, rather than committing to ongoing monthly payments without measurable results, as in the past, which didn't work and left me stuck in reports instead of performance.
Ideally, I would like to:
- Agree on a price and achievable ranking target for each keyword or group of keywords. - Select the initial number of keywords based on the proposed pricing and difficulty. - Make milestone payments when agreed ranking improvements are achieved and sustained, independently verified through SERPRobot and Search Console. - Once rankings are achieved, establish an ongoing monthly maintenance agreement to help preserve and improve those results. - Gradually add more keywords to the campaign as our budget allows and earlier targets are achieved.
I understand that Google rankings cannot be guaranteed, so open to reasonable recommendations on milestones, verification periods and realistic timeframes.
**Advice requested**
Could your Recruiter team please advise:
1. Whether you can identify experienced overseas SEO freelancers willing to work under this type of performance-based arrangement. 2. What a realistic budget would be for different levels of keyword competition. 3. How you recommend structuring milestone payments and ongoing maintenance fees. 4. Whether technical SEO improvements should be included or quoted separately. 5. Whether your Recruiter service can help shortlist suitable candidates with proven WordPress/WooCommerce SEO experience.
We would prefer to discuss the proposed structure and indicative costs before posting the project.
Thank you, and I look forward to your advice.

item.title: WordPress Rebrand for Project Controls
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | **WordPress Website Rebrand and Design Refresh: Salient / WPBakery**
We are seeking an experienced WordPress designer/developer to rebrand our existing website from **CMC Project Solutions** to **Clarity Project Controls**.
Current website: [www.cmcprojectsolutions.com](https://www.cmcprojectsolutions.com/)
We provide project controls, construction consulting, scheduling, and Oracle Primavera services. The refreshed website should present a professional, credible business serving engineering, construction, utility, and infrastructure clients.
Our site uses the **Salient/ThemeNectar theme**. We want to improve the design within our existing WordPress setup while preserving valuable content, media, and functionality. We have a color palette and implementation guide to share.
**Scope of work**
1. **Review and design mockups** - Review the existing theme, page builder, plugins, and page structure. - Recommend practical improvements to layout, navigation, readability, and mobile usability. - Provide homepage and leadership-section mockups for approval before implementation.
2. **Rebranding and visual consistency** - Apply the Clarity Project Controls name and supplied logo across the agreed pages. - Update navigation, headers, footers, buttons, forms, browser icons, and page titles/descriptions. - Apply our palette consistently: - Primary navy: #0A2540 - Accent blue: #0066FF - Hover blue: #0052CC - Soft gray: #F4F5F7 - Body text: #0F172A - Muted gray: #64748B - Use white and soft gray content backgrounds, navy headings, blue accents, and a navy footer with white text and links.
3. **Homepage and content improvements** - Preserve the existing infrastructure hero video and real project photographs. - Apply a navy overlay to the hero video, with a white headline and blue call-to-action button. - Improve the presentation of services, case studies, and contact information. - Make WBE, DBE, and Oracle credentials more prominent using approved wording and assets. - Keep animation restrained and purposeful.
4. **Leadership section** - Create a compact, consistent layout for the four leadership profiles. - Use clear photographs, names, and roles, with accessible biographies. - Reduce unnecessary scrolling while maintaining a usable mobile layout.
5. **Implementation, testing, and handover** - Work on a development/staging copy for review before launch. - Preserve existing content, links, forms, and integrations unless changes are agreed. - Test navigation, forms, video, and layouts across desktop and mobile browsers. - Check readability, hover states, and loading performance. - Provide a brief handover explaining how we can maintain the updated pages. - Include a defined period of post-launch support.
Please identify downloadable documents that need separate branding updates. Any domain migration, email migration, new logo design, or substantial copywriting should be quoted separately.
**Experience we are looking for**
- Proven WordPress experience with Salient/ThemeNectar and WPBakery. - Strong design skills for professional services or other business websites. - Experience refreshing established websites while preserving existing functionality. - Clear communication and a structured review process.
**Please include in your proposal**
- Two or three relevant website examples, preferably built with Salient, and your role in each. - Your recommended approach and any concerns identified from reviewing our site. - A fixed-price quote with a clear page list, deliverables, and exclusions. - Your availability, estimated timeline, and proposed milestones. - The number of revisions and length of post-launch support included. - Any additional theme, plugin, or licensing costs.
We will provide the branding guide, approved logo assets, existing content, and access needed for the agreed work. We are collecting proposals for team review and will approve the design direction before implementation.
